# Harnesses

A harness is the runtime that executes your agent loop.

You can start a native harness session directly from the CLI without writing
agent YAML:

```
omni claude
omni codex
omni pi
```

See [Terminal](/docs/interact/terminal) for more launch commands.

To select a harness in agent YAML, swap one line:

```
executor:
  harness: claude-sdk
```

Tools, policies, prompts, and models stay the same across harnesses — only the
runtime underneath changes.
